limitations: Corresponding axes, different game data and mechanics; not an equivalent-physics kernel regression.
Old resultSha256 hashes public projections and logs, preserving Map/Set/non-finite values, not the full state instance.
Legacy native null endline drains its event queue; matched variant explicitly supplies prep + battle duration.
Legacy loadout/passive/hit hydration is outside timing; current service runtime preparation is inside timing.
Cold first means first simulation after module/data/import setup, not application startup.
No browser Worker transport/UI/rendering, memory peak/leak or cache benefit measured.
